result.summary: This urban street features continuous sidewalks and a signalized intersection with marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the environment lacks physical buffers between pedestrians and traffic, and sightlines at the intersection are partially obscured by on-street parking.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching or turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no physical separation or planting strip to protect pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalks on both sides of the foreground roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous but cracked sidewalk adjacent to a vacant lot and blank building walls. The lack of a buffer between the walkway and the roadway, combined with parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines, creates a functional but low-quality pedestrian space.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk shows significant cracking and uneven surfaces, posing a trip hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, parked black SUV

hazards.name: Lack of Passive Surveillance
hazards.description: The vacant lot and blank building walls create a space with no active frontage, potentially impacting personal safety perceptions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures specifically designed to illuminate the sidewalk area to improve visibility and safety at night.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. The environment is dominated by on-street parking and utility infrastructure that occasionally obstructs the walkway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and debris on the left sidewalk narrow the effective walking path.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks at the intersection or mid-block, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A line of parked vehicles on the right side of the street creates sightline issues between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the nearest intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking a paved sidewalk and forcing pedestrians onto an unpaved shoulder shared with parked vehicles. A large blank wall creates a sterile environment with no natural surveillance, further degrading the walking experience.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk on uneven dirt and gravel surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground along the white wall

hazards.name: Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white pickup truck is parked directly on the unpaved area where pedestrians would naturally walk.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large windowless wall provides no eyes on the street, reducing perceived and actual safety for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Large white building wall in the center

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk with a raised curb to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic and parking.

interventions.title: Parking Management
interventions.description: Define on-street parking spaces with markings or bollards to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.
